svg.title: Inputs, nuclei and outputs of the amygdala. Inputs from the associative cortex, thalamus, hippocampus, prefrontal cortex and brainstem (glutamatergic) and from VTA, DRN, LC and BF (neuromodulatory) reach the lateral, basal, central and medial nuclei (LA, BA, CeA, MeA). BA sends glutamatergic outputs to EC, mPFC, hippocampus, NAc and BNST; CeA sends GABAergic outputs to SNL, LC, NTS, VTA, PAG, PBN, BF, hypothalamus and BNST; MeA sends GABAergic outputs to NAc, BNST, hypothalamus and BF. Each output is labeled with the behavior it serves, such as freezing, anxiety, reward, hormones or feeding.
